rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child. Both are extended resignation-acceptance letters that begin by acknowledging the recipient's desire to relinquish demanding duties, review service spanning the predecessor's administration and momentous wartime and postwar years, identify major organizational achievements, specify the resignation's effective date, and close with national gratitude. C16 and C03 share the resignation-and-tribute function, but their wording and internal sequence are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your efforts have indeed been time consuming. They justify your desire to relinquish active association with this great organization in order to return to private pursuits.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am therefore fully cognizant of the considerations which prompt your desire to relinquish your duties as the Secretary of Defense.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel acknowledgment of the recipient's reasons and 'desire to relinquish' his duties.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Accordingly I have no recourse but to accept, effective as of October first next, your resignation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I accept your resignation effective at the close of business on March thirty-first.
shared_material.explanation: The operative acceptance and effective-date formula are materially parallel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You have directed Red Cross activities through momentous years, both in war and in peace
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your service ... embraced those momentous months that preceded Pearl Harbor, as well as all the war years and the critical period that has followed the cessation of hostilities.
shared_material.explanation: Both immediately frame the recipient's record through momentous wartime and postwar service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: When my predecessor appointed you ... in midsummer, 1944
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your service to your country ... during this administration and that of my predecessor
shared_material.explanation: Both emphasize service extending from the predecessor's administration into Truman's.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For all that you have achieved you have earned the thanks of your government and of the great American people.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For all that you have done in your country's behalf ... I tender you heartfelt assurance of my gratitude and appreciation.
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel concluding expression of gratitude for service to the country.
